description:
Modern bikes with classic, timeless construction techniques. Our hand-selected 22-series artisan bikes feature custom lugs joined with a mix of KVA and Reynolds stainless steel. If you are a rider with a keen eye for detail and tradition, the Wateford 22-series is your answer.

Lugged bicycle frames have many advantages over Tig-welded frames. First, properly fitting lugs will distribute tube junction stresses over a greater area. This leads to a more refined, predictable ride that will last many years to come.

Stainless steel is comprised of a minimum of 10.5% chromium. The added chromium, when contacted with air, creates a very thin, nearly invisible layer of chromium oxide, which seals the surface of the steel to prevent moisture and oxygen from creating rust.

This characteristic, combined with high tensile strength and work-hardened, cold-drawn tubes, creates a lighter-weight, more responsive ride when compared to modern chromoly steel tubes. This is achieved through very thin yet strong butted sections of our hand-selected tubesets.

When it comes to finishes, our 22-Series Artisan models are highly customizable. Please reach out for ideas or pitch your dream bike.

Our 22-Series bicycles have no model names. Each frame we craft is an involved and intimate conversation about what your new bike needs to do for you.
